title: Garbage feeding prohibited; penalty.
bodyText:
(a) The feeding of garbage to swine is prohibited, unless:

(1) A permit to process (cook) garbage for such use is obtained from the department of agriculture and biosecurity's division of animal industry; and

(2) The garbage has been processed (cooked) under conditions and procedures established by departmental rules.

(b) Any person who violates subsection (a) shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.

§142-23.5  Garbage feeding prohibited; penalty.  (a)  The feeding of garbage to swine is prohibited, unless:

     (1)  A permit to process (cook) garbage for such use is obtained from the department of agriculture and biosecurity's division of animal industry; and

     (2)  The garbage has been processed (cooked) under conditions and procedures established by departmental rules.

     (b)  Any person who violates subsection (a) shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. [L 1982, c 148, §1; am L 2025, c 235, §15 and c 236, §17]
